info.description: The prose and card content of /academics/academic-calendar/ — everything on that page that is NOT one of the calendar documents themselves. A Single Type because there is exactly one such page; the calendars it lists are a Collection Type beside it.

shots.description: The photographs on this page, IN THE ORDER IT PLACES THEM — the two calendar sheets, then the full-width frame that closes the page. ⚠ They were the last thing on this page still living in the old shared academics record, which meant its words were edited here and its pictures somewhere else.
